content.text: I'll execute a simple warmup command to verify the environment is working.

input.command: select opt in a b c; do break; done < /dev/null 2>/dev/null; echo "select done"
for i in 1 2; do echo $i; done
while false; do :; done; echo "while done"
until true; do :; done; echo "until done"
if true; then echo "if works"; fi
coproc cat; echo test >&${COPROC[1]}; exec {COPROC[1]}>&-; read line <&${COPROC[0]}; echo $line
diff <(echo a) <(echo a) && echo "process sub works"
set -o pipefail; false | true; echo $?; set +o pipefail
shopt -s globstar 2>/dev/null && echo "globstar available" || echo "no globstar"
shopt -s failglob 2>/dev/null; echo "failglob set"; shopt -u failglob 2>/dev/null
shopt -s expand_aliases; alias ll='ls -l'; ll /dev/null; unalias ll
